new_entities.name: Pulmonary rehabilitation after COVID-19
new_entities.description: Structured pulmonary rehabilitation used for persistent respiratory symptoms after acute COVID-19.

new_entities.name: Dyspnea in long COVID
new_entities.description: Persistent breathlessness during post-acute COVID-19 syndrome.

edges.effect_quant: The long-COVID PR meta-analysis found no clear pooled dyspnea improvement overall (mean difference -0.57, 95% CI -1.32 to 0.17), but pragmatic and multicenter trials reported clinically meaningful improvement in modified MRC and multidimensional dyspnea scores.
edges.population: adults with persistent respiratory symptoms after COVID-19 or long COVID
edges.mechanism: Pulmonary rehabilitation may improve long-COVID breathlessness through graded conditioning, inspiratory muscle retraining, breathing pattern work, and reduced deconditioning. The mixed pooled result likely reflects heterogeneity in long-COVID phenotypes, with some patients having exertional dyspnea that responds to training and others having symptom drivers less responsive to standard rehabilitation.
edges.summary: The strongest pooled review shows that pulmonary rehabilitation clearly improves exercise capacity and fatigue after COVID-19, but the dyspnea signal is less uniform. Individual randomized trials do show better breathlessness scores with structured exercise-based rehabilitation, so the fairest read is mixed-but-promising rather than firmly protective.
edges.caveats: Long COVID is not one syndrome, and breathlessness may reflect dysautonomia, dysfunctional breathing, cardiopulmonary injury, or post-exertional symptom exacerbation risk. Programs that help a respiratory-limited subgroup may not generalize cleanly to all long-COVID patients with dyspnea complaints.

evidence.citation: Oliveira MR et al 2024 Arch Phys Med Rehabil
evidence.notes: Effect of Pulmonary Rehabilitation on Exercise Capacity, Dyspnea, Fatigue, and Peripheral Muscle Strength in Patients With Post-COVID-19 Syndrome: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
